# NearMe India — Autonomous B2B Wholesale & Medical Bill Audit Network

> Canonical URL: https://www.nearme-india.org
> Support Desk: 24/7 Autonomous Self-Support AI Concierge (EN, HI, KN, TA, TE, MR)

## Core Capabilities
- **Unlimited-Page (1 to 500+ Pages) Streaming Bill Auditor (`/api/engine`)**: Audits hospital ICU bills, car/bike service workshop invoices, construction BOQs, pharmacy ledgers, gold making quotes, CSV/XLSX wholesale books, and multi-photo bills page-by-page against NPPA, CGHS, Jan Aushadhi, and regional wholesale ceilings.
- **15/85 Protected Wholesale UPI Escrow & MSME Section 43B(h) (`/escrow`, `/api/escrow`)**: 48-hour refund guarantee, 6-digit delivery OTP payout release, and optional 3% MSME Day-1 invoice discounting via Razorpay Live Checkout.
- **Public Pan-India Local Business Directory (`/shops`, `/shop/[slug]`, `/search`)**: Continuously updated index of local diagnostic labs, plumbers, electricians, AC technicians, car/bike garages, hardware/cement dealers, and pharmacies across 19,300+ Indian pincodes with 30-second free shop claiming (`/claim`) and 2 complimentary customer leads.
- **Free Verified Shop QR Standee & Digital Business Card (`/card`)**: Free tool for Indian shop owners to generate a printable counter QR standee (PNG) with optional Mod-36 GSTIN verification seal and shareable WhatsApp business card.
- **Instant e-Court, GSTIN Mod-36 & Consumer Forum Trust Shield (`/api/verify`)**: Real-time 15-character GSTIN Mod-36 checksum validation and e-Daakhil Section 35 consumer notice generation.
- **24/7 Autonomous Customer & Supplier Self-Support (`/contact`, `/api/support`)**: Zero-human-intervention resolution across English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, and Marathi.
